note: Held-out edge-case probes, one node:test test per id, named '<id>: ...'. A probe marked strict depends on a reading of the spec that it does not state outright; it is reported but also excluded in passed_excluding_strict.

probes.strict: the spec says a page outside 1..pageCount never throws; omitting the options object entirely is a borderline reading of that

probes.check: the CONFIG_INVALID throw for '{', 'null', '[]' and pageSize 0 is an Error
expiresAt === now leaves the price unchanged
an expired percent coupon leaves the price unchanged
a coupon with no kind throws code COUPON_INVALID
the COUPON_INVALID throw is an Error
formatItem({ id: 'x', label: 'Café Crème', priceCents: 0 }, 'USD') deepEqual the exact BEH-5 shape
extra input keys (stock, currency) do not reach the output: keys are exactly id, label, price, slug
price keys are exactly cents, currency
price.currency comes from the argument, not item.currency
signToken output equals base64url(JSON payload) + '.' + base64url(HMAC-SHA256(secret, first part))
verifyToken(signToken(p, s), s) deepEqual p for a nested payload
a token signed with another secret verifies to null
a swapped first part under the original signature verifies to null
an altered signature (first character) verifies to null
a truncated or empty signature verifies to null without throwing (timingSafeEqual length mismatch)
a correctly signed first part that is not JSON verifies to null without throwing
probes.strict: reads a token whose payload part is not JSON as malformed; the spec states never-throws but not this case's return value

probes.check: null, undefined, 123 and {} as the token verify to null without throwing
probes.strict: reads a non-string token as malformed; the spec does not name non-string input

probes.check: page 1 of 3 items, pageSize 2: status 200, the two formatted items, page 1, pageCount 2, total 3
page 2: the remaining formatted item, page 2
page 5: no throw, status 200, items [], pageCount 2, total 3
an empty catalog: status 200, items [], pageCount 0, total 0
items carry the handler's currency and their slugs
the response keys are exactly status, body and the body keys exactly items, page, pageCount, total
probes.strict: BEH-7 says 'returns { status: 200, body: { items, page, pageCount, total } }' without BEH-5's 'exactly'

probes.check: typeof handlers.list === 'function' in the registry module
dispatch of an unregistered name deepEqual { status: 404 }
